name: tmcra-memory-mobile
description: TMCRA native Android audio-memory client with local speaker identity and text-only remote memory retrieval

scripts.android:debug: npm run test && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/build-android.ps1 -Task assembleDebug
scripts.android:release: npm run test && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/build-android.ps1 -Task assembleRelease
scripts.android:bundle: npm run test && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/build-android.ps1 -Task bundleRelease
scripts.ios:sync: npm run test && cap sync ios
